failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days after TRANSIT crosses below -33 and stays there.

evidence_refs: fact:workplace and transit mobility are still deeply depressed in the snapshot

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the week after PARKS rises by at least 5 points from a sub-10 level.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines in the two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM moves above -2 from a weaker prior week.
